dependency_edges.handoff: Five topology and message features become the logistic classifier inputs.
The classifier is evaluated and regularized through the 15 leave-one-out folds.
The base 0.27 error and missing message meaning motivate semantic diffusion.
The selected semantic topic is fed back into the logistic feature system for retraining.
Because conspiracy likelihood is not leadership, the workflow switches to a filtered LeaderRank model.
Changed labels and topics trigger a full classifier rerun followed by rank and probability sensitivity checks.
